newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba's Welteke - EMU criteria flexibility limited.
newsitem.headline: Buba's Welteke - EMU criteria flexibility limited.

text.p: Bundesbank council member Ernst Welteke said on Monday Europe's planned currency union does not permit a loose interpretation of entry criteria although some flexibility is enshrined in the document.

"Flexibility in the interpretation of the entry criteria (for Europe's planned currency union) is greater than often described but this flexibility is limited and cannot be used arbitrarily," Welteke said in a text prepared for delivery.
Welteke, also the president of the state central bank in Hesse, was scheduled to address a group of foreign bankers and a copy of the speech was made available ahead of delivery.

Welteke, like several Bundesbank colleagues, said that nations must stick to efforts to pare back government spending and debt not only to meet the entry criteria for monetary union but also because high expenditures brake economic growth.
He said that nations were already making progress on keeping inflationary pressures in check and harmonising interest rate levels.
